## Change and reason

Describe the user-visible change and the problem it solves.

## Data and attribution

For factual or media changes, provide primary source links, the date checked,
and any creator/license/modification details. For translations, identify the
languages and explain any deliberate differences from the English meaning.
Leave note GUIDs and existing field order unchanged when updating notes.

## Validation

List the exact checks run and their results. For template or translation changes,
include the inspected language, viewport and theme. State any checks that could
not be performed and why.

## Compatibility

Describe any migration, import-setting or release-documentation changes needed.
